title: A chat session whose history holds an image with a lost stored copy still answers its next turn, instead of failing every turn as TRANSPORT
steps: S1: Common setup. The stand's dsh-home must be bind-mounted on the host (scv2: ~/TCH-local/scv2/dsh-home, with attachments/ and sessions/); chrome-watch must answer on http://127.0.0.1:9222; the stand's model route must accept images.

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node tasks/evidence/chat-missing-attachment/reg046.mjs ~/TCH-local/scv2 scv2wp $Q/reg046 (stand dir, site label, output dir). It signs in as scv2-a, opens the site's chat, attaches a freshly drawn PNG and sends 'REG-046 step 1: reply with exactly one word: received', waits for that turn's turn/end in the session log, deletes the attachment object(s) the turn wrote under dsh-home/attachments, then sends 'REG-046 step 2: reply with exactly one word: second' in the same session and waits for its turn/end.

S3: Read the script's output lines 'turn 1 end', 'attachment objects written', 'turn 2 end', 'turn 2 llm/retry events', 'VERDICT', and the exit code. If 'turn 1 end' is an error, or 'attachment objects written 0', the case is BLOCKED (the setup did not happen), not FAIL.
expect: 'turn 1 end' is {"kind":"completed"} and 'attachment objects written' is at least 1 (the image was stored and then removed).

'turn 2 end' is {"kind":"completed"}: the turn after the stored copy was removed finishes. Before the fix it was {"kind":"error","error":{"message":"DeepSeek Messages transport failed","code":"TRANSPORT"}}.
'turn 2 llm/retry events 0': no retry of the second turn (before the fix: 3 retries, all TRANSPORT).
The script prints 'VERDICT: PASS' and exits 0.
evidence: tasks/evidence/chat-missing-attachment/ (red and green runs on scv2, 04/10/2026)
fence: dsh-llm readRequestImages: a lost image before the latest user message becomes a text note; an unreadable image in the latest message fails as ATTACHMENT_MISSING, never TRANSPORT
